resale_co.name: Sale Certificate of Occupancy and Certificate of Land Use Compliance
requirements: Curb and sidewalk free of trip hazards
All railings and spindles in place (36 inch rail height)
Window screens in place from May 15 to October 1
ABC fire extinguisher with the gauge in the green (required for sales)
Smoke alarms in each bedroom, on each level and within 10 feet of all bedrooms; CO alarm on each sleeping floor and near any major gas appliance
If smoke detectors are monitored, a certificate from the alarm company
Two outlets in each bedroom; bathroom outlet plus a fan or exhaust window
Water heater pressure relief valve discharge checked
Unit clean: no mold in tub, clean rugs, no chipping paint

fees.label: Sale Certificate of Occupancy, non-refundable (form updated 4/11/25)
Each form, per Code Enforcement FAQ (older figure; conflicts with the current forms)
fees.quote: In order to sell your home you will need a Land Use and Sale Certificate of Occupancy (per unit). Each form is $50.00 due at the time of scheduling.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Submit two forms from the Housing page to the Building / Code Enforcement Department, City Hall, 6201 Atlantic Avenue: the Sale Certificate of Occupancy Application (buyer, agent, proposed settlement date, whether smoke detectors are monitored, and the adults and children who will live in each unit) and the Application Certificate of Land Use Compliance (seller, property, zoning and use). A Certificate of Occupancy is needed per unit. Pay when the inspection is scheduled (cash, check or card). Housing inspections run Monday to Friday, 9:30 am to 1 pm, every half hour. The Housing page also posts a Rental-Sale Affidavit and a 'Conditional Letter - Unoccupied' form.

resale_co.notes: The Code Enforcement FAQ says a Land Use certificate and a Sale Certificate of Occupancy (per unit) are needed to sell a home. Fee conflict: the FAQ says each form is $50.00, but the current posted forms (Sale CO updated 4/11/25, both files dated January 2026) each show $100; the forms are probably current, but confirm. The Code Enforcement page sidebar lists cmalfara@ventnorcity.org for Housing and dmanera@ventnorcity.org for Building; Pam Learn is listed as Inspector (plearn@ventnorcity.org, 609-823-7987). Rentals need their own CO (monthly and yearly rentals) or a mercantile license (short-term); those are not resale items.

requirements: Smoke alarms: one in each bedroom, one on each level, and one within 10 feet of all bedrooms (battery or hardwired accepted)
Carbon monoxide alarm on each sleeping floor and near any major gas burning appliance, per the manufacturer's instructions
Portable fire extinguisher, required for sales only: ABC type, no larger than 10 pounds, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen, gauge in the green (City letter, 2008 scan, and current FAQ)

authorities.name: Ventnor City Building / Code Enforcement Department (smoke, CO and extinguisher check within the Sale Certificate of Occupancy)
authorities.how_to_apply: No separate smoke certificate application or fee was found. The City's Certificate of Occupancy requirements letter says smoke alarms, CO alarms and portable fire extinguishers are required before any Certificate of Occupancy is issued, and the state fire directory lists the Ventnor City Building Department for smoke detector compliance, so the check is made during the Sale Certificate of Occupancy inspection.

fire_cert.notes: Ventnor's fire code enforcing agency is the Ventnor City Fire Department (LEA code F), but its Fire Prevention page lists only business registration, rental property registration and permit forms, with nothing on resale smoke certificates. The state fire directory names the 'Ventnor City Bldg Dept' for smoke detector compliance, and the City's CO requirements letter ties the smoke/CO/extinguisher check to the Certificate of Occupancy, so the Building / Code Enforcement Department is listed. Fire Bureau contacts, if needed: the City web page lists Thomas Halpin, Fire Official/Fire Inspector, 609-823-7943, thalpin@ventnorcity.org; the Bureau's 2026 registration form and the state directory list Lt. Joseph Iannuzzelli as Fire Official (jiannuzzelli@ventnorcity.org).
